data.acceptance:
1. Production rulesets protect every v2 proposal, generation/archive, and control-epoch ref with zero bypass actors: unique ref creation is allowed, while updates, deletions, and non-fast-forward writes are denied to everyone; legacy freeze remains staged disabled for knots-d6e4.
2. Clients publish only c472 self-signed immutable proposal refs whose name includes writer, sequence, and proposal OID. No mutable inbox or writer registry exists; provider integrator knots-d6dd consumes proposals directly and derives registration and sequence from the signed chain plus canonical writer vector.
3. Phase A ships the reusable control-epoch attester and verifier with an empty fail-closed trusted-signer allowlist. After merge SHA A is reviewed, an active zero-bypass authority-code ruleset is read back before creating a random immutable authority ref at exact SHA A.
4. Phase B allowlists only the exact tuple of authority ref, SHA A, and .github/workflows/knots-v2-control-epoch.yml. Dispatch occurs from that protected ref; authority verification binds acartine/knots, exact workflow, source ref, signer/source digest A, monotonic epoch, writer dominance, and referenced OIDs.
5. Live canaries prove ordinary unique creation succeeds, ordinary and Actions rewrite/delete fail, trusted Actions attestation verifies with exact authority-ref/SHA/workflow binding, and ordinary unattested lookalikes fail before production v2 rules are applied and read back.
